decisions.reason: Although the online portal is relatively distant from the paper-display core and needs ongoing IT effort, it supports deeper customer collaboration and stronger information security, so its option value still justifies keeping it while adoption remains uncertain.

This packaging display solution is close to the firm's core capabilities and its 2024 packaging award is a strong positive signal that the option has substantial realized value, making withdrawal unlikely.
The quarter-pallet pegboard display is a close extension of the established display business, and with low carrying cost and still-unresolved market upside the firm would likely keep it on offer.
The small counter display fits existing design, printing, and assembly capabilities, so despite limited evidence so far its low cost of continuation makes keeping it the more likely choice.

The large freestanding information display is also a close-to-core variant, and even if demand is not yet proven the firm can retain this option at modest incremental cost while it learns about customer uptake.
